visual_grammar.background: full-bleed matte near-black charcoal with a subtle deep-evergreen vertical gradient bloom from upper left to lower right, faint fine-grain paper texture, and occasional soft radial amber glow behind key diagrams only
visual_grammar.foreground: warm bone text and cool pale-sage secondary text, with high-contrast white used only for key numeric callouts and device labels
visual_grammar.accent: restrained oxidized amber used consistently for signal paths, highlights, key metrics, active nodes, and emphasis rules
visual_grammar.typography: crisp neo-grotesk sans serif; bold large sentence-case headers, medium-weight body copy, tight all-caps micro-labels, and sparse monospaced code snippets or schema fragments for proof objects
visual_grammar.diagram_style: precise systems-architecture graphics with thin strokes, rounded-corner modules, minimal fills, amber signal lines, pale node labels, small iconography, and disciplined use of arrows, brackets, and decision branches
visual_grammar.panel_style: dark evergreen-black translucent panels with soft inner shadow, subtle 1px bone or desaturated green keylines, rounded 12px corners, and generous padding; no heavy drop shadows
visual_grammar.grid_system: 12-column grid with wide outer margins, left-aligned headers, consistent top title band, modular card zones, and asymmetrical two-column compositions that prioritize one dominant artifact plus one supporting text/metric column
visual_grammar.line_weight: 1px hairlines for dividers and frames, 2px for primary diagram connectors, 3px maximum for emphasis bars and key metric underlines

storyboard.title: BloomOS
storyboard.purpose: Hero cover slide establishing BloomOS as a serious, infrastructure-grade plant intelligence platform. Speaker note focus: do not argue yet; simply set the tone with confidence, restraint, and local-first hardware plus intelligence.
storyboard.image_prompt: Create a clean full-bleed digital screenshot of a single presentation slide, exported edge-to-edge with no software chrome and no page number or pagination indicator anywhere. This is the one and only cover slide. Use generous negative space. Dominant centered-left wordmark text: 'BloomOS'. Beneath it, one short tagline only: 'Dependable plant care, closed loop.' On the right half, show one strong hero visual: a refined conceptual product render mockup of the BloomHub 8 on a dark surface with several tether lines extending gracefully toward out-of-focus indoor potted plants, emphasizing a calm systems object rather than a gadget. No charts, no diagrams, no bullets, no data, no extra labels beyond the company name and tagline. The slide should feel premium, architectural, calm, and inevitable.

storyboard.title: Redrawing the Category
storyboard.purpose: Open the argument by repositioning BloomOS from plant gadget to integrated hardware-and-intelligence platform. Speaker notes: the category mistake is app-first thinking; BloomOS is infrastructure for living systems.
storyboard.image_prompt: Create a clean full-bleed digital screenshot of a single presentation slide, exported edge-to-edge with no software chrome and no page number or pagination indicator anywhere. Layout: large title top left, then a two-column comparison with a narrow left column labeled 'What plant tech usually is' and a wide right column labeled 'What BloomOS is'. Left column contains three stacked muted cards with simple icon sketches and short phrases: 'app-first advice', 'single-metric sensors', 'cloud-dependent accessories'. Right column contains one dominant architecture panel with the phrase 'Integrated local-first plant intelligence platform' and three linked modules beneath: 'trusted sensing + actuation', 'schema-bound interpretation', 'dependable execution online or offline'. Add a concise bottom strip with four short proof statements sourced from the pitch: 'wall-powered', 'connects up to 8 plants', 'local control', 'PAW nutrition option'. No unsupported claims. Make the composition feel like a strategic reframing, not marketing.

storyboard.title: The Friction Behind the Green Rush
storyboard.purpose: Define the problem operationally: plant care fails because existing tools do not create dependable care loops. Speaker notes: avoid sentimental framing; highlight inconsistency, drop-off, and poor system design.
storyboard.image_prompt: Create a clean full-bleed digital screenshot of a single presentation slide, exported edge-to-edge with no software chrome and no page number or pagination indicator anywhere. Layout: title top left; left side contains a concise paragraph block summarizing the source problem in structured prose: indoor plant ownership is growing, but the honeymoon phase ends when plants wilt and die; consumers lack the tools, time, and data for resilient plant care. Right side shows a visual failure-chain diagram with four stacked stages connected by arrows: 'new plant enthusiasm' -> 'generic advice and cheap sensors' -> 'inconsistent care and silent stress' -> 'plant death, frustration, drop-off'. Along the bottom, a thin band with three concise issue cards: 'advice is non-executable', 'battery sensors are scattered architecture', 'cloud dependence is fragile for living systems'. Use no made-up statistics on this slide.

storyboard.image_prompt: Create a clean full-bleed digital screenshot of a single presentation slide, exported edge-to-edge with no software chrome and no page number or pagination indicator anywhere. Show four main nodes in a circular or left-to-right loop: 'Plant + environment signals', 'BloomHub sensing + local state machine', 'Schema interpretation layer', 'Water / light / nutrient actions'. Add three short support captions around the loop using exact pitch concepts: '100% local watering logic', 'last known optimized schedules persist if internet fails', and 'data-driven care and automated optimization'. On the far right margin, a small explanatory text block describing BloomOS as an integrated local-first plant intelligence and nutrition ecosystem for the modern home.

storyboard.purpose: Demonstrate how BloomOS translates noisy biological data into bounded decisions rather than generic advice. Speaker notes: show process discipline and action boundaries.
